Wifi Mancer is a native macOS app for local device visibility and experimental network administration. The community direction is accurate observations, clear states, reliable cleanup and evidence-led device identification.

Current targeting is IPv4 on compatible local networks. A peer Mac cannot reliably establish every device's physical join/leave event or control every router, isolated client or alternate internet path. Armed, targeted and independently verified outcomes are different facts. This project does not promise universal internet blocking.

Use Issues for reproducible defects and identification fixtures, Ideas for proposals, Q&A for questions, and Show and tell for redacted work and measured results. Read CONTRIBUTING.md and LICENSE before submitting or distributing code. Follow SECURITY.md for vulnerabilities; never disclose them in public threads.

Only work on networks and devices you own or are explicitly authorized to administer. Remove credentials, SSIDs, real addresses, device UUIDs, serials, personal names and local paths from public material. No community post authorizes disruptive tests or media playback.

The first priorities are session cleanup truth, fresh ownership/presence evidence, durable ordered events, correct capture accounting and consistent device labels/icons. Command recipes and their prerequisites still need review and reproducible verification; inclusion in the catalog is not certification.
